output:
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , ... > .
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , 'members' : (UserY , Rest) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , 'members' : (UserY , Rest) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'cloudOpenWindow' deviceB | (FreshKey) .
[B2] < deviceB | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'cloudOpenWindow' deviceB | (NewKey)
=> < deviceB | 'key' : NewKey , ... > .
[B2] < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ cloudA 'cloudOpenWindow' deviceB | (NewKey)
=> < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > if K =/= nils .
[B3] < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : Trusted , ... > $ UserX 'bind' deviceB | (Key)
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , ... > .
[B4] < deviceB | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'on' : true , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOnDevice' deviceB .
[B5] < deviceB | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Trusted) , 'on' : false , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOnDevice' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Trusted) , 'on' : true , ... > .
[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Rest , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .

< cloudA | (userA : ('members' : nils , 'device' : deviceB) , userC : ('members' : nils , 'device' : nils)) > < userA | ('key' : nils) > < userC | ('key' : nils) > < deviceB | ('trusted' : cloudA , 'on' : false , 'key' : nils) >

[B1] < UserX | ... > < UserY | ... > => ev1(UserX, UserY) .
[B2] < UserX | ... > < deviceB | ... > => ev2(UserX) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < deviceB | ... > => ev3(UserX, Key) .
[B4] < UserX | ... > < deviceB | ... > => ev4(UserX) .
[B5] < UserX | ... > => ev5(UserX) .
[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ... > < UserY | ... > => ev6(UserX, UserY) .

deviceOn =| < deviceB | 'on' : true , ... > .
attackerAuthorized =| < cloudA | userC : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > .
